## February Expense Policy Violations

**3 violations** across 8 submitted expense lines, totaling **$1,512.40** in out-of-policy spend.

| Report | Employee | Date | Category | Amount | Issue |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| **EXP-1042** | K. Osei | Feb 9 | Meals | $132.90 | Exceeded $75/day cap → **$57.90** over |
| **EXP-1047** | D. Kim | Feb 17 | Airfare | $1,386.00 | Business class, transcontinental — no VP pre-approval on file → full amount |
| **EXP-1051** | K. Osei | Feb 24 | Supplies | $68.50 | No receipt attached for a line over $25 → full amount |

**Worst violation:** Rule 2 (Airfare) — D. Kim's $1,386 business-class ticket dwarfs the other two combined. That one needs a VP sign-off or it's a full write-off.
